note: chromeStoreId is the id of the published Chrome Web Store item (chromewebstore.google.com/detail/kjfgpfhdfdilbkibcegclnbnlfkokcke): every policy names it, and this file is the only place it is written (a test in agent/internal/core fails when it changes). devId comes from the public key in ext/manifest.json 'key' (dev builds only; store builds strip it); it is used only when chromeStoreId is null. The private key is kept outside the repository. amoSlug is the add-on's name in its addons.mozilla.org address.
